summary.text: Find your property's Annual Value through the IRAS e-Valuation List, your property tax bill, or myTax.iras.gov.sg.

steps.name: Check the IRAS list
steps.text: Find your residence's Annual Value in the IRAS e-Valuation List. A nominal fee applies.

steps.name: Check other records
steps.text: You can also check your property tax bill or log in to myTax.iras.gov.sg.

example_phrasings: How do I find out what is the Annual Value of my Property?
How can I check my property's Annual Value?
Where can I find my property's AV?

sources.page_title: How do I find out what is the Annual Value of my Property?

quotes.text: You can find out about the AV of your residence from IRAS e-Valuation List at a nominal fee.
You may also check your property tax bill or log in to myTax.iras.gov.sg.
